name: Cinderbrand
text: Melee attacks also send a wave of fire forward for {wave} weapon damage.

name: Trident of Embers
text: Pierce skills throw {count} extra projectiles in a fan.

name: Gauntlets of the Tide
text: Pierce projectiles fly back to you at the end of their path, hitting again.

name: Grip of the Reaper
text: Every 3rd melee attack hits all around you for {ringMult}× damage.

name: Pyre Mail
text: Fire skills ignite enemies, burning for {igniteMult} of the hit over 3 seconds.

name: Heart of Ash
text: Enemies killed by fire skills explode for {explodeOnKill} of their max life.

name: Comet Treads
text: Dash skills leave a burning trail for 3 seconds.

name: Hollow Diadem
text: Your minions explode for {burst} weapon damage when they expire.

name: Bulwark of Cinders
text: Shouts also blast enemies in their radius for {shoutDamage} weapon damage.

name: Frostgrip Bracers
text: Cold skills slow {slowPct}% more and slowed enemies take 20% more damage from you.

name: Girdle of Momentum
text: Dashing resets the cooldown of your secondary skill.

name: Eye of the Rift
text: Projectile skills fire {count} extra projectile and fly 40% faster.

name: Band of Echoing Cries
text: Shout skills have half the cooldown.

name: Ember Loop
text: Fire skills make enemies take {vulnOnHit}% more damage for 3 seconds.
